method: Reconciled every actual retained UAE service/matter route against current local rendered HTML, existing question/answer inventory, integrated UAE source records and earlier individual substantive reviews. Compared targeted remaining intents with official sources and added six answers. This final pass is a source/gap reconciliation, not a fresh exhaustive legal review of every sentence or an all-keyword census. It deliberately preserves specific unresolved public intents while separating stale integration flags and file-specific application.
materialFindings: Article 54 conflict resolved: official Arabic Decree-Law 9/2024 replacement text p1 names First Instance, not the Court of Appeal still present in the MOHRE consolidated English PDF. The 2023 procedural resolution was not used to publish the current court.
Consumer Protection Articles 12/13 support general defect and repeated-defect remedies but do not establish unrestricted consumer choice or a universal change-of-mind refund.
Federal Civil Procedure Articles 152/153 distinguish intermediate rulings and service-trigger exceptions. These are not DIFC/ADGM rules.
Sanadak eligibility is a gate, not an entitlement to reimbursement; its current published waiting condition is 15 calendar days.
Broad service navigation can fulfill its bounded purpose while associated matter-level remedy questions remain open. No global first-page ranking or every-possible-intent completion claim is made.

sourceEvidence.finding: Decree-Law 9/2024 p1, substituted Article 54(2)-(3), official indexed Arabic operative text inspected. Direct fetch returned403; not represented as a complete downloaded PDF.

Official indexed full service text: Ministry database condition; identity details; website/app; supporting claim documents; free service; 14 working days listed as service completion duration, not the judicial challenge clock.
Indexed Article54 retains Court of Appeal wording alongside2024 amendment note; this contradictory English wording was not adopted.
Official indexed Articles152/153 read. Uncertain English dismissal/stay translation exception omitted; answer lists only verified examples, not exhaustive exceptions.
Official indexed Articles12/13 read; executive conditions expressly preserved.
Current official eligibility page read, including prior complaint,15calendar days and court/mandate/policy exclusions.
